channel.title: Jacob C. Smith — Blog
channel.description: Long-form writing on data science, ML systems, local-first AI, and the practice of building.

item.title: From Satellites to Street Signs: How the WVRTP App Finds You
item.description: A case study on the WVRTP facility inspection system for Readyfuels: how a static React SPA proves an inspector is physically on-site using the browser Geolocation API, OpenStreetMap reverse-geocoding, and a backend-free pipeline straight into Microsoft 365.

item.title: The Recursive Tree: Why I Built a Consciousness Simulator on a Phone
item.description: A generative art piece — recursive fractal tree, particle petals, bloom intensity — turns out to be a visual rendering of the Multiversal Consciousness Framework. Here's why I built it on a phone.

item.title: Embedded Agents on the Edge: UNIHIKER K10, ESP32-S3, and a Local MCP Gateway
item.description: A deep dive on the embedded + edge-AI thread of the practice — why local-first matters for agent infrastructure, what's in the UNIHIKER K10 skill package, how the ESP32-S3 firmware is structured, and how the local WebSocket MCP gateway brokers it all back to JCLAW and MCPStarfleetCommand.

item.title: Consciousness as a Spectral Filter: A Mathematical Framework
item.description: What if consciousness isn't a substance or a place, but a process—specifically, a dynamic filter operating in frequency space? Here I unpack the core mathematics behind the EMERGENT-MCF-EI framework.

item.title: Peace as Voltage: Why Harmony Requires High-Tension Infrastructure
item.description: Stability is not the absence of conflict. It is the successful management of opposing forces through robust infrastructure. A deep dive into the 'high-tension wiring' model of conflict resolution.

item.title: Building Local-First AI: Why Zero Telemetry Changes Everything
item.description: When you run an LLM locally with zero telemetry, something changes. Not just privacy—the entire relationship between developer and model shifts. Here's what I learned building JCLAW.
